original_title: Gold Declines as Uncertainty Surrounds Progress in US-Iran Talks
title: Gold Declines as Uncertainty Surrounds Progress in US-Iran Talks
original_summary: Gold was on track for a weekly loss as uncertainty persisted over progress in US-Iran talks to end the war that’s roiled global markets.
